correctness.rationale: The mechanism definitions were reconstructed with exact rational arithmetic. Independent enumeration gives n=1: one equal profile; n=2: four equal profiles; n=3: 144 equal and 72 incomparable profiles. For n=4, independent enumeration of all 17,550 anonymous ranking multisets with exact label multiplicities gives 72,288 equal, 11,664 PS-dominant, and 247,824 incomparable labeled profiles, totaling 331,776 and giving 11,664/331,776=9/256. The package's independent Burnside/object-relabel route yields 209/36/517 symmetry classes, and its exhaustive dominance stratum gives exactly four two-order classes. Finite enumeration is exhaustive here because the theorem itself is confined to n<=4.
